OR_ODR1.claim: Koraput's hills are known for Kotpad handloom, coffee plantations and tribal culture.

evidence.quote: Famous for its Kotpad handloom weave, aromatic coffee plantations, and breathtaking landscapes

OR_ODR2.claim: Best October to March; plan 3 days. Visakhapatnam airport is about 170 km away; Jayapur station is about 22 km and Koraput Junction about 30 km.

evidence.quote: Best Time October to March Duration 3 Days
Visakhapatnam International Airport – Approx. 170 km (nearest major airport)
Jayapur Railway Station – Approx. 22 km; Koraput Junction – Approx. 30 km

OR_ODR3.claim: Deomali, at about 1,672 m, is Odisha's highest peak; open 5 am–6 pm, free.

evidence.quote: Rising to about 1,672 metres, Deomali is the highest peak in Odisha
Timings 5:00 AM – 6:00 PM Entry Fee Free

OR_ODR4.claim: Duduma falls drops about 157 m on the Machkund river; open 6 am–5 pm, best October–February.

evidence.quote: Formed by the Machkund River as it plunges dramatically from a height of around 157 meters
Timings 6:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Best Time to Visit October - February

OR_ODR5.claim: OTDC's Deomali Nature Camp is the preferred stay; there is also a Panthanivas at Jeypore.

evidence.quote: Deomali Nature Camp (OTDC) is the preferred stay.
Panthanivas Jeypore Town Area, Jeypore, Koraput

OR_ODR6.claim: Things to do include sunsets over Kolab reservoir, the Putsil valley, Gupteswar cave temple and the tribal weekly haats.

evidence.quote: Witness breathtaking sunsets over Kolab Reservoir
Walk through the scenic Putsil Valley
Explore the sacred Gupteswar Cave Temple
Experience vibrant tribal haats (weekly markets)

OR_ODR7.claim: Ask permission before photographing people, especially in tribal areas.

evidence.quote: Ask for permission before taking photos of people, especially in tribal areas.

OR_ODN1.claim: Ratnagiri was a centre of Mahayana and Vajrayana Buddhism from the 5th to 13th centuries CE and is part of Odisha's Diamond Triangle, known for its carved doorways and votive stupas.

evidence.quote: was a thriving centre of Mahayana and Vajrayana Buddhism between the 5th and 13th centuries CE
Part of Odisha's renowned Diamond Triangle
one of the country's largest concentrations of votive stupas

OR_ODN2.claim: Open 9 am–5 pm; ₹25 for Indians and SAARC nationals, ₹300 for foreigners; best October–March; there is an on-site ASI museum.

evidence.quote: Best Time to Visit Oct - Mar Ideal Duration 2–3 hours Timings 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Entry Fee ₹25 for Indians & SAARC Nationals; ₹300 for Foreigners
Visit the ASI Museum

OR_ODN3.claim: By road it is 30 km from Jajpur Road, 55 km from Kataka (Cuttack) and 100 km from Bhubaneswar; Udayagiri is 10 km and Lalitagiri 25 km away.

evidence.quote: Accessible by road from Jajpur Road (30 km), Kataka (55 km) & Bhubaneswar (100 km)
Udayagiri Monastery 10.0 KM Lalitagiri Buddhist Complex 25.0 KM

OR_ODN4.claim: Lalitagiri, one of Odisha's oldest Buddhist sites, completes the Diamond Triangle with Ratnagiri and Udayagiri; excavations found relic caskets. Open 6 am–6 pm with a nominal fee and a site museum.

evidence.quote: Lalitgiri is one of Odisha's oldest and most significant Buddhist heritage sites
It forms part of the renowned Buddhist Diamond Triangle, along with Ratnagiri and Udayagiri.
Timings 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM Entry Fee Nominal entry fee
Visit the Site Museum

OR_OZK1.claim: Best October to March; open 8 am–5 pm; closed May 1 to July 31 for crocodile breeding; entry fees as per forest department norms.

evidence.quote: Best Time to Visit October - March Ideal Duration 1–2 days Timings 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
(Seasonal Closure: May 1 to July 31 for the crocodile breeding season)
Entry fee applicable as per forest department norms

OR_OZK2.claim: Eco nature camps at Dangmal and Gupti are the stays for nature lovers; Panthanivas Bhubaneswar is the alternative.

evidence.quote: Eco Nature Camps at Dangmal and Gupti are ideal for nature lovers. Panthanivas Bhubaneswar is a convenient alternative, along with nearby hotels.

OR_OZK3.claim: A Ramsar Site, it has India's largest saltwater crocodile population.

evidence.quote: the largest population in the country
Designated a Ramsar Site

OR_ODD1.claim: Chandipur is known for its vanishing sea: at low tide the water recedes 3–5 km, so you can walk out over the seabed.

evidence.quote: known for its rare vanishing sea phenomenon
During low tide, the sea recedes up to 3–5 km
allows visitors to walk deep into the sea bed

OR_ODD2.claim: Best October to March; open 24 hours, free.

evidence.quote: Best Time to Visit October – March
Timings Open 24 hours Entry Fee No entry fee

OR_ODD3.claim: Baleshwar is the nearest station; Bhubaneswar airport is about 200 km away.

evidence.quote: Rail Nearest railway station – Baleshwar
Biju Patnaik International Airport, Bhubaneswar (Approx. 200 km)

OR_ODD5.claim: OTDC's Panthanivas Chandipur is on the beach.

evidence.quote: Panthanivas Chandipur Chandipur Beach, Chandipur, Baleshwar
Stay at Panthanivas Chandipur

OR_ODS1.claim: Similipal Tiger Reserve covers 2,750 sq km — Odisha's largest protected area — with peaks over 1,500 m; it is a Project Tiger reserve and UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.

evidence.quote: Spread across 2,750 sq km the Similipal Tiger Reserve is one of India’s richest biodiversity landscapes and Odisha’s largest protected area.
peaks like Khairiburu and Meghashini rising to over 1,500 metres
Similipal is now a key tiger habitat under Project Tiger and a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.

OR_ODS2.claim: It is known for rare melanistic (black) tigers, elephants, gaur, leopards and 300+ bird species; Barehipani and Joranda falls are best after the monsoon.

evidence.quote: It is globally known for its rare melanistic (black) tigers
along with elephants, gaurs, leopards and over 300 species of birds
spectacular waterfalls like Barehipani and Joranda best seen after the monsoon

OR_ODS3.claim: Best November to June; open 6 am–6 pm, with entry fees as per forest department norms.

evidence.quote: Best Time to Visit November - June
Timings 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM
Entry fee applicable (as per forest department norms)

OR_ODS4.claim: Baleshwar is the nearest station (about 60 km from Baripada); Bhubaneswar airport is about 250 km away. Joranda falls is 5 km and Barehipani 10 km from the park.

evidence.quote: Rail Nearest railway station – Baleshwar
Baleshwar Railway Station – Approx. 60 km
Biju Patnaik International Airport, Bhubaneswar – Approx. 250 km
Joranda Waterfall 5.0 KM Barehipani Waterfall 10.0 KM

OR_ODS5.claim: OTDC's Panthanivas Baripada, near Similipal, is the recommended base.

evidence.quote: Panthanivas Baripada Near Simlipal, Baripada, Mayurbhanj
Panthanivas Baripada (OTDC) is recommended

OR_ODP1.claim: Sambalpur, on the Mahanadi in western Odisha, is anchored by the Samaleswari Temple and known for Sambalpuri handloom, folk music and dance.

evidence.quote: Sambalpur is a vibrant cultural hub shaped by the Mahanadi, where devotion and tradition come together.
Anchored by Samaleswari Temple and enriched by Sambalpuri handloom and folk traditions, it also offers scenic escapes at Hirakud Dam.

OR_ODP2.claim: Best October to March; plan 2 days. Jharsuguda airport is about 55 km away; Sambalpur City Junction serves the town.

evidence.quote: Best Time October to March Duration 2 days
Veer Surendra Sai Airport, Jharsuguda – Approx. 55 km
Nearest Railway Station(s): Sambalpur City Junction

OR_ODP3.claim: Top sights: Samaleswari Temple, Hirakud Dam, the Leaning Temple of Huma and the Kardola weavers' village; Debrigarh offers wildlife safaris.

evidence.quote: Top Attractions Maa Samaleswari Temple Hirakud Dam Leaning Temple of Huma Kardola Weavers Village
Experience a wildlife safari at Debrigarh

OR_ODP4.claim: The 16th-century Samaleswari Temple is open 5:30–11:30 am and 3–9 pm, free; a light and sound show runs 7–7:40 pm daily except Mondays. It comes alive at Nuakhai, the harvest festival.

evidence.quote: Built in the 16th century by Raja Balaram Dev
Timings 5:30 AM to 11:30 AM and 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM Light & Sound Show: 7:00 PM to 7:40 PM daily (except on Mondays) Entry Fee No entry fee
The site comes alive during Nuakhai, the harvest festival where farmers offer their first grains

OR_ODP5.claim: OTDC's Panthanivas Sambalpur is recommended; hotels and resorts are available across the city.

evidence.quote: Panthanivas Sambalpur (OTDC) is recommended, with hotels and resorts available across the city.

OR_ODH1.claim: Hirakud Dam on the Mahanadi near Sambalpur is one of the world's longest earthen dams, over 25 km, built soon after Independence for flood control, irrigation and power.

evidence.quote: Recognized as one of the longest earthen dams in the world, the structure extends for over 25 kilometers
the dam was envisioned as a multi-purpose project aimed at flood control, irrigation, and power generation

OR_ODH2.claim: Gandhi Minar and the Jawahar (Nehru) Minar give panoramic views; migratory birds arrive in winter.

evidence.quote: Explore Gandhi Minar & Jawahar Minar
attracting migratory birds during the winter months

OR_ODH3.claim: Open 6 am–6 pm, free; best October–February; allow 2–3 hours.

evidence.quote: Best Time to Visit October - February Ideal Duration 2–3 hours Timings 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM Entry Fee No entry fee

OR_ODH4.claim: Jharsuguda is the nearest airport and Sambalpur the nearest station. Samaleswari Temple is 15 km and Debrigarh 25 km away.

evidence.quote: Air Nearest airport – Veer Surendra Sai Airport, Jharsuguda Rail Nearest railway station – Sambalpur
Maa Samaleswari Temple 15 KM Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary 25 KM

OR_OZB1.claim: Bhubaneswar, the Temple City, is best October to March; plan 2 days.

evidence.quote: Known as the Temple City
Best Time October to March Duration 2 Days

OR_OZB3.claim: Mo Bus air-conditioned coaches link Bhubaneswar, Cuttack and Puri; app cabs and taxis are widely available.

evidence.quote: Mo Bus connects Bhubaneswar, Kataka, and Puri through modern, air-conditioned coaches
App-based cab services and private taxis are widely available in major urban centers including Bhubaneswar, Kataka, and Puri.

OR_ODC3.claim: Kataka Railway Station serves the city; Biju Patnaik International Airport, Bhubaneswar, is the nearest airport; buses, trains and taxis link it to Bhubaneswar.

evidence.quote: The city is served by Kataka Railway Station, while Biju Patnaik International Airport, Bhubaneswar, is the nearest airport.
Regular buses, trains, and taxis connect it to Bhubaneswar and other major cities.

OR_ODJ1.claim: Raghurajpur, 14 km from Puri, is India's first heritage crafts village, famous for Pattachitra painting; almost every household practises a traditional art.

evidence.quote: Raghurajpur Heritage Village, located just 14 km from Puri
Recognized as India’s first heritage crafts village, Raghurajpur is famous for its Pattachitra paintings
almost every household in the village is engaged in some form of traditional art

OR_ODJ3.claim: Open 9 am–6 pm, free; best October–March; 2–3 hours. Pipili is 25 km away.

evidence.quote: Best Time to Visit October – March Ideal Duration 2–3 hours Timings 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Entry Fee No entry fee
Pipili 25.0 KM

OR_ODI1.claim: Pipili in Puri district is renowned for appliqué work (chandua), used in Jagannath Temple rituals and for decorating the Rath Yatra chariots; the craft has GI status.

evidence.quote: Pipili, located in the Puri district of Odisha, is a vibrant craft village renowned for its traditional appliqué work, locally known as “Chandua.”
especially for decorating chariots during the famous Ratha Jatra
which has been granted Geographical Indication (GI) status

OR_ODI2.claim: It lies on the Bhubaneswar–Puri highway (NH-316); shops are open 9 am–8 pm, free, best October–March.

evidence.quote: Located on Bhubaneswar–Puri highway (NH-316)
Best Time to Visit October – March Ideal Duration 1–2 hours Timings 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM Entry Fee No entry fee

OR_ODY1.claim: Chandrabhaga beach, 3 km from Konark Sun Temple, draws thousands at Magha Saptami (January–February) and hosts the International Sand Art Festival.

evidence.quote: the beach comes alive every year during Magha Saptami (January–February)
hosting the International Sand Art Festival
Konark Sun Temple 3.0 KM

OR_ODY2.claim: Open 24 hours, free; best October–February; known for sunrises.

evidence.quote: Best Time to Visit October – February Ideal Duration 1–2 hours Timings Open 24 hours Entry Fee No entry fee

OR_OZP1.claim: Best October to March; plan 2 days. Puri has its own railway station; Bhubaneswar airport is the nearest, 60 km away.

evidence.quote: Best Time October to March Duration 2 days

OR_OZP4.claim: Jagannath Temple is open roughly 5 am–11 pm (varies with rituals), free; the Blue Flag Golden Beach is 2.5 km away.

evidence.quote: Timings 5:00AM – 11:00 PM varies with rituals Entry Fee No entry fee
Puri Beach & Golden Beach (Blue Flag Beach) 2.5 KM

OR_OZN1.claim: Open 6 am–8 pm; best October–February; the light and sound show runs 7:30–8:20 pm (March–November) and 6:30–7:20 pm (December–February).

evidence.quote: Best Time to Visit October – February Ideal Duration 2–3 hours Timings 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM
Light & Sound Show Timings: 7:30 PM to 8:20 PM (March to November) 6:30 PM to 7:20 PM (December to February)

OR_ODM3.claim: Best November to February; open 6 am–6 pm; no entry fee but boat charges apply; allow 3–4 hours.

evidence.quote: Best Time to Visit Nov – Feb Ideal Duration 3–4 Hours Timings 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM Entry Fee No entry fee (Boat charges applicable)

OR_ODB1.claim: Daringbadi, the 'Kashmir of Odisha', is a hill station in Kandhamala with pine forests, coffee gardens and winter temperatures that can dip close to freezing.

evidence.quote: Fondly known as the “Kashmir of Odisha”, Daringbadi is a refreshing hill station nestled in the highlands of Kandhamala.

OR_ODB2.claim: Best October to February; open 24 hours, free.

evidence.quote: Best Time to Visit October - February
Timings Open 24 hours Entry Fee No entry fee

OR_BEST1.claim: October to March is the peak season, at about 10–27 °C; summer (March–June) can cross 40 °C; the monsoon runs July–September.

evidence.quote: October to March The Golden Season • Peak Tourist Time

OR_BEST2.claim: Winter suits temples, Chilika's migratory birds, camping and beach festivals; summer suits hill stations such as Daringbadi and Koraput; the monsoon fills the waterfalls and brings the Ratha Jatra (June/July).

it's the best time to visit waterfalls and hill stations like Daringbadi to escape the heat

Attending the Grand Ratha Jatra (June/July)

OR_BEST3.claim: Festival calendar: Mukteswar Dance Festival (January) and Dhauli Kalinga Mahotsav (February) in Bhubaneswar, Ratha Jatra in Puri (June/July), Konark Festival (December).

evidence.quote: January Winter Mukteswar Dance Festival Bhubaneswar
February Winter Dhauli Kalinga Mahotsav Bhubaneswar
June / July Monsoon Ratha Jatra (Car Festival) Puri
December Winter Konark Festival Konark

OR_AIR.claim: Biju Patnaik International Airport, about 6 km from Bhubaneswar's centre, is the main gateway; Veer Surendra Sai Airport (Jharsuguda) also operates. Bhubaneswar station has express and superfast trains from across India.

itineraries.title: Koraput in 4 days: Deomali, Duduma and the southern highlands
itineraries.summary: Odisha's southern hills: sunrise on Deomali, the state's highest peak, the 157 m Duduma falls, Kolab reservoir, Gupteswar cave and a tribal haat.
itineraries.seoDescription: 4 days in Koraput: Deomali (1,672 m), Duduma falls, Kolab sunset, Gupteswar cave and tribal haats, with official hours and how to get there.

plan.overview: Koraput is Odisha's southern highland — coffee, Kotpad weaving, tribal markets and big landscapes. Odisha Tourism suggests three days; this plan adds a fourth so you can catch a weekly haat. Base yourself at OTDC's Deomali Nature Camp or Jeypore.

guides.title: How to reach and get around Odisha

guides.seoTitle: How to Reach Odisha and Get Around
guides.seoDescription: Getting around Odisha: Bhubaneswar airport, main railway stations, Mo Bus and OSRTC buses, app cabs, and routes to Puri, Koraput and Sambalpur.

body.intro: Bhubaneswar is Odisha's gateway, and the Bhubaneswar–Cuttack–Puri triangle is well served by buses and cabs. The hills and the west need a train or a car.

items.title: By air
items.body: Biju Patnaik International Airport is about 6 km from Bhubaneswar's centre and the main gateway; Veer Surendra Sai Airport at Jharsuguda serves the west.

items.title: By rail
items.body: Bhubaneswar has express and superfast trains from across India; Puri, Cuttack, Brahmapur and Baleshwar are the other key stations.

items.title: Mo Bus
items.body: Air-conditioned coaches link Bhubaneswar, Cuttack and Puri.

items.title: OSRTC
items.body: Intercity coaches to major towns and pilgrimage sites.

items.title: Cabs
items.body: Odisha Yatri, Ola and Rapido in the cities; chauffeur-driven cars for sightseeing and intercity trips.

items.title: Puri
items.body: 60 km from Bhubaneswar, with its own station.

items.title: Koraput
items.body: Visakhapatnam airport is about 170 km; Jayapur station about 22 km.

items.title: Sambalpur
items.body: Jharsuguda airport is about 55 km; Sambalpur City Junction serves the city.

items.title: Similipal
items.body: Baleshwar station is about 60 km from Baripada.

checklist: Fly or take a train to Bhubaneswar.
Use Mo Bus for the Bhubaneswar–Cuttack–Puri triangle.
Hire a car for Koraput and the national parks.

guides.title: Best time to visit Odisha: seasons, parks and festivals
guides.summary: October–March is peak season; summer suits the hills, the monsoon fills the waterfalls, and the festivals worth timing a trip around.
guides.seoTitle: Best Time to Visit Odisha: Season by Season
guides.seoDescription: When to visit Odisha: October–March peak season, hill stations in summer, monsoon waterfalls, park closures, and Ratha Jatra, Konark and Bhubaneswar festivals.

body.intro: Odisha is a year-round destination, but October to March — dry and cool at about 10–27 °C — is the best time for temples, beaches and wildlife.

items.title: Winter (October–March)
items.body: Peak season, about 10–27 °C. Temples, Chilika's migratory birds, camping and beach festivals.

items.title: Summer (March–June)
items.body: Often over 40 °C; head for the hills — Daringbadi and Koraput.

items.title: Monsoon (July–September)
items.body: Green landscapes and waterfalls at their fullest; the Ratha Jatra falls in June or July.

items.title: Daringbadi
items.body: October–February; winter nights can be near freezing.

items.title: Bhitarkanika
items.body: October–March; closed May 1–July 31.

items.title: Similipal
items.body: November–June.

items.title: Mangalajodi
items.body: November–February for the migrants.

items.title: Mukteswar Dance Festival
items.body: January, Bhubaneswar.

items.title: Dhauli Kalinga Mahotsav
items.body: February, Bhubaneswar.

items.title: Ratha Jatra
items.body: June or July, Puri.

items.title: Konark Festival
items.body: December, Konark.

items.title: Magha Saptami
items.body: January–February, Chandrabhaga beach.

checklist: Plan October–March for most of the state.
Book Puri early for the Ratha Jatra.
